name: readlink
summary: Read the value of a symbolic link.
description: Prints a symbolic link target or resolves a path according to the selected option.

options.description: Canonicalize by following every symlink and resolving components.
Canonicalize and require every component to exist.

examples.title: Print a link target
examples.explanation: Displays the target stored in the symbolic link.

examples.title: Resolve an absolute path
examples.explanation: Follows links and normalizes path components.

examples.title: Resolve an existing path
examples.explanation: Requires the resolved path to exist.
